effects: The router takes `amount` of suniBTC from the signer (stored as `uniBTC`, initialized to 0x8731…129d) through safeTransferFrom, using the signer's allowance.
The router records a delayed redeem for the signer in `token`, worth `amount` minus a fee set by the storage value `redeemFeeRate`.
The fee part stays in the router as a management fee when the signer claims.
The signer can claim `token` only after `redeemDelay`, which is 7 days at initialization, in a separate claimDelayedRedeems call.
When `amount` is 0, nothing moves and no request is created.
formats.shown: The screen says "Redeem 0.0001 suniBTC with a delay, a fee may apply" and shows the token to receive and the suniBTC amount submitted.

findings.title: createDelayedRedeem interpolatedIntent leaves out the token the signer receives, which is shown only as a field.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json createDelayedRedeem: "interpolatedIntent": "Redeem {amount} with a delay, a fee may apply", while the field `#.token` 'Token to Receive' renders "uniBTC" (case 0) or "WBTC" (case 1). DelayRedeemRouter.createDelayedRedeem stores `token: token` in the DelayedRedeem record.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Redeem {amount} for {token} with a delay, a fee may apply".

findings.title: createDelayedRedeem cannot show the fee rate, the delay or the amount the signer receives later.
findings.evidence: DelayRedeemRouter.createDelayedRedeem: `uint224((amount * (REDEEM_FEE_RATE_RANGE - redeemFeeRate)) / REDEEM_FEE_RATE_RANGE)`; `redeemDelay` is storage (604800 s at initialize in meta.json constructor data). The intent says "a redeem fee may apply", which is accurate. Case 0 shows only the 0.0001 suniBTC out.

cases.notes: The only signer effect is 0.0001 suniBTC to the router. The approval event to 0 is the allowance spent by that transfer, so it is merged with it. The reader got the amount, asset and the delayed uniBTC payout right.

effects: The signer receives every matured delayed redeem, in order, up to the first one that has not matured. Each is paid in its own token (ERC-20 or native BTC) from the vault, with the amount net of fee.
The signer's delayedRedeemsCompleted counter advances, so the claimed requests are closed.
The router burns the matching suniBTC that it holds. The signer pays nothing out.
formats.shown: The screen says "Claim all delayed redeems" with no fields.

findings.title: claimDelayedRedeems shows no token or amount received, because both come from storage.
findings.evidence: Case 2: the signer receives 0.0001 uniBTC (0x004e…0568) from the vault 0xb8b0…2230, and the screen shows only "Claim all delayed redeems". DelayRedeemRouter._claimDelayedRedeems reads tokens and amounts from `_userRedeems[recipient]` via _getDebtTokenAmount. The function has no parameters.

cases.notes: The signer receives 0.0001 uniBTC. The screen states a claim to the signer but no asset or amount, which no descriptor can show. The reader expected funds to arrive, with the asset and amount unknown.
